prompts.title: Dapper Duo
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference for both father and baby. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, and natural imperfections — no alteration.
Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion editorial portrait with old money aesthetic and subtle 90s luxury magazine vibe.

Composition & Framing (LOCKED)
Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio (strict)
Subjects occupy ~70-80% of frame height
Medium portrait (mid-thigh up)
Centered but slightly organic framing (not perfectly symmetrical)

Pose & Body Language (CRITICAL FIX)
Father is NOT standing straight —
Body slightly relaxed with a subtle natural lean (micro-tilt in shoulders and torso)
Weight shifted more onto one leg (effortless stance, not posed)
Head subtly tilted (optional)
Right hand inside trouser pocket
Left arm supporting baby across torso
Baby positioned naturally across arm, legs angled outward, body slightly diagonal (not stiff or upright)

Expression & Attitude
Direct gaze at camera
Attitude, serious, slightly intimidating
Quiet luxury presence — effortless dominance, not posed fashion energy
Styling & Clothing 

Father:
Crisp white dress shirt, perfectly tailored (Oversized, loose, visible wrinkles)
Clean structure along arms, chest, and waist
Top 2–3 buttons open, sharp collar
High-waisted pleated black trousers with defined structure
Baby:
Mini version outfit of father
Slight natural looseness (baby fit), but still structured

Accessories (LOCKED)
Both wearing thin gold metal-frame sunglasses (90s minimal luxury style)

Background (LOCKED)
Dark vertical wooden slats
Fine texture clearly visible
Subtle lower panel seam + small hardware detail
No blur-heavy background

Lighting (90s EDITORIAL FIX)
Soft diffused frontal light
Slightly flatter lighting style (less modern HDR contrast)
Gentle shadows, controlled highlights
Subtle film-like softness (not ultra-digital sharpness)

Camera & Quality (MAJOR FIX)
85mm lens
f/2.8
Eye-level shot
Slight film grain / analog softness
Reduced digital sharpness
Editorial magazine quality — not ultra-HD modern AI look

Color & Grade (IMPORTANT)
Neutral tones
Slightly muted blacks (not crushed)
Soft whites (not overly crisp)
Very subtle warm tone
Hint of 90s film color grading

Style Keywords
old money aesthetic, 90s editorial fashion, analog film look, quiet luxury, masculine elegance, minimalist luxury portrait
